lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters are organized into distinct vertical columns posterior to the gill region, with a higher spatial frequency of spots observed in the dorsal-ventral axis compared to the anterior-posterior axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the high-intensity blobs, particularly visible in the region immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit, creating a rudimentary grid pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal ridge is visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with a light-reflective upper edge and a shadowed lower margin, running parallel to the dorsal midline.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a dense distribution of small, high-luminance spots that are significantly smaller in diameter than the spots on the primary lateral flank.
